description:
[Step 1 of find_a_clinician · optional]

Takes a parent's concern and returns a recommended path: crisis resources when there is danger, the service that fits (therapy, medication, ADHD or autism testing, or a clinical matching session), matched clinicians with their next opening, and related care resources. Says so when the family's state is not one Emora serves.

Use when: A parent has described a concern and the next step (crisis help, a clinician, reading, or all three) is not yet clear.

Don't use when: A clinician is already chosen: get_availability and get_booking_link cover the rest.

Example: recommend_care({ concern: "Teacher thinks my 9-year-old may have ADHD", state: "Texas", age: 9, insurance: "Aetna" })

concern.description: What the parent is worried about, in their words.

insurance.description: Insurance plan name, or "Cash Pay" for self-pay. A plan Emora does not take is ignored, and the result says so.

service.description: Optional; inferred from the concern when omitted. therapy, clinical-matching, medication, adhd-testing or autism-testing.

state.description: U.S. state, full name or 2-letter code. For a state Emora does not serve, the result says so and lists alternatives.

name: recommend_care
title: Recommend care for a concern
